name: Extraversion
description: Sociability, assertiveness, enthusiasm, and energy gained from external stimulation — seeking company, speaking up, and driving action.
low_description: Preference for solitude, quiet reflection, and inner world — reserved, independent, and energized by alone time.

name: Openness
description: Curiosity, creativity, imagination, and willingness to engage with new ideas, unconventional experiences, or aesthetic and intellectual pursuits.
low_description: Preference for routine, convention, and the familiar — practical, traditional, and skeptical of abstract ideas.

name: Neuroticism
description: Emotional volatility, anxiety, self-doubt, or vulnerability to stress — tendency toward negative emotion and difficulty under pressure.
low_description: Emotional resilience, calm under pressure, and consistency of mood — rarely rattled by stress or setbacks.

name: Agreeableness
description: Cooperation, empathy, trust, and warmth — tendency to prioritize harmony, accommodate others, and avoid conflict.
low_description: Skepticism, bluntness, self-interest, and willingness to challenge others — competitive, critical, and unsentimental.

name: Conscientiousness
description: Organization, discipline, reliability, and goal-directed behavior — planning ahead, following through, and exercising self-control.
low_description: Spontaneity, flexibility, and tolerance for disorder — impulsive, adaptable, and resistant to rigid structure.
